question.text: The typical organisational structure of a PMS includes:

answer.text: Principal Officer, Compliance Officer, Fund Managers, Dealers — with segregation of duties

explanation.text: The Logic: Standard PMS: PO (investment head), Compliance Officer (independent), Fund Managers (execute strategy), Dealers (place trades). Duties segregated to prevent conflicts. The Trap: Lean structures with combined roles are compliance risks. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B specific. Manager's Pro-Tip: Implement dealer-portfolio manager separation via OMS workflows — SEBI inspections verify this.
